title: CBS will weigh 'impact on our image' in Tony Romo return decision, exec says

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: CBS will weigh 'impact on our image' in Tony Romo return decision, exec says
sources.description: CBS NFL announcer Tony Romo, who is part of the network's to broadcast team, was placed on indefinite leave following his July 23 OWI arrest. Here's the latest.
